source.original_question:
Find the area of the green figure.
Choices:
A:9
B:18
C:72
D:144

adaptations.reason: Replaced color-dependent green reference with smaller shaded figure; explicitly states the source-implied similarity. Decorative fill of larger figure removed while smaller target region stays gray.

independent_solution.method: Corresponding diagonals have ratio 4/8=1/2. Area of the smaller similar figure=36*(1/2)²=9 square yards.
